name: retention-guard
description: Guard a config trim so the load-bearing lines survive. Use on "check this trim", "did the slim lose anything".

# retention-guard

The load-bearing line of this fixture is the next one, and it is the whole point
of the fixture: a slim that drops it must be reverted, not applied.

- Never delete a line marked as never-remove, however long it looks.
- Always re-measure after a trim so the delta is real rather than claimed.

## Checklist

1. Copy the original aside before editing.
2. Apply the proposed trim.
3. Run the retention gate over the pair.
4. On a breach, restore the copy and record the loss.
